author: Chris Graham

modules.name: Help
modules.description: Option-click any control, jack or module title for a note saying what it does

description: In-rack help: option-click any control for a note on what it does, with text for over four thousand modules, generated by analysis of their open source code, documentation, change notes and more. Makers can ship their own notes as a JSON file inside their plugin, and those take precedence.
